questions.feedback: That trap answer is the one to unlearn: Adding powers: 2^3 + 2^4 = 2^7. Reteach point: The index rule is for multiplying, never adding: 8 + 16 = 24, not 128. Always work out each power first when the question adds.

questions.answer: 25 is a multiple of 5 (5 x 5), so it has more than two factors; the primes just below and above it are 23 and 29.
questions.feedback: Scene s1 fixes this: the sieve crosses out multiples of 5, so 25 falls, while 23 survives because it is divisible only by 1 and itself.
questions.prompt: In one sentence, say why 25 is not a prime and name the primes just below and above it.

questions.feedback: Scene s2: multiplying with the same base adds the indices, 5 + 2 = 7, and the base stays 2. Multiplying the indices or changing the base are the slips to watch for.
Scene s3: the point moves four places left to give 4.5, which sits between 1 and 10, so the power of ten is 4.
